title: My first camping trip was a disaster
L: (1) Hoa: My first camping trip was a disaster, but I still laugh about it.
We reached the campsite after dark, and then we found out we had forgotten the tent poles.
It was too late to drive home, so we tied the tent to two trees.
Around midnight it started to rain, and the whole tent fell on our heads!
(2) Phong: That's hilarious! I was cooking sausages on a camping stove when a dog stole them.
Now I always keep my food in a sealed box when I camp.
(3) Mai: Your story is so funny that I am still smiling!
Next time, make a packing list and ask a friend to check it.
Bad trips often make the best stories, don't they?

exq.q: What did Hoa and her friends forget?
Why did they not drive home?
w: They wanted to sleep in the car.
exq.why: “It was too late to drive home”.
